commit.message:
Revert "Increase regions per worker to 20"

This reverts commit d19e675f0912f7a804d2370cf1756c47cc3ccdaa.

Further improvements

There was an issue with waste accounting, which made me rethink the
large object forwarding. Now large objects can forward to any lower
region, including sliding past each other.
Some refactoring along the way, and settled on 'large object' naming
instead of 'pinned'.

Increase regions per worker to 20

Now that we have a different solution for large objects,
we no longer need to maximize region size. 100 regions per
worker seems more reasonable. Smaller regions help with
some forms of compaction waste.

Refinements

Refactoring, doc updates, logging, tidy-ups.

Fix bug

If compaction point exactly ends at end of region, we can forget to
advance the compaction region.

Compaction improvements

Large objects crossing region boundaries are pinned
Normal objects compact around pinned objects
A final serial pass compacts pinned objects

Seems to basically work, not stress tested.
